column1: #Backward-pass mutation coverage, re-run from probes/audit_exp2_mutation.py on FarmShare (CPU).
#Shape B2 T64 H2 K64 V64 R2. Acceptance criterion is the repo's own bf16 gate: max|diff| < 0.02 (ATOL=RTOL=2e-2).
#Regimes differ ONLY in the decay-gate parameterization:
#  accept = naive -rand() gate (the gate the original acceptance test used)
#  real   = production A_log = log U(1,16), i.e. 8-68x stronger decay
#A mutation "PASSES" when its induced error falls under the acceptance threshold, i.e. the test FAILS to catch a real bug.
#dg reference magnitude by regime: accept 1.750e-01, real 1.562e-03, negeig 3.195e-03.
#M1 corrupts dg almost completely (relative error ~99%) yet lands under a flat 2e-2 absolute
#threshold whenever the production gate collapses |dg| to ~1e-3. A per-gradient RELATIVE error
#test is required; the repo has test_kda_householder_backward_relative_error, the mutation
